## Purpose

Evaluate cumulative untreated outcomes for covariate-adjusted placebo models. Produce full/restricted sample performance tables and figures analogous to the no-covariate analysis.
Reuse the diagnostic and numeric cutoff recorded in the **no-covariate**
`analysis/3.1a.4_heldout_decision.yml`; do not choose a new cutoff here. The rule is applied
**separately to each covariate model**, so retained county samples can differ.
Default evaluation is half B from the original fixed split. The full-sample tables
below refer to all available counties **within that evaluation half**. 3c.1 is optional
historical exploration and is not required by this workflow.


```{r}
# Check the frozen no-covariate rule and covariate inputs before computing performance.
# Read the same county split; retain only the evaluation half before scoring any rows.
source("R/backdate_helpers.R")
source("R/heldout_analysis.R")
root <- find_backdate_root()
evaluation_half <- "B"
decision <- read_decision(root)
covariate_input_dir <- file.path(root, "data/derived/heldout/with_covariates")
covariate_output_dir <- file.path(root, "_output/heldout/with_covariates/performance")
dir.create(covariate_output_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
heldout_input <- load_heldout_half(root, evaluation_half, input_dir = covariate_input_dir)
if (nrow(heldout_input$manifest) != heldout_input$expected_groups)
  stop("3c.2 requires all 18 covariate backdated checkpoints; finish 2c.1 and refresh 3c.0.")
covariate_diagnostics <- derive_heldout(heldout_input$rows)$rows
prepared_paths <- file.path(root, c("data/derived/heldout/with_covariates/sim_fits_wcov.rds",
                                  "data/simulation/sim_fits_wcov.rds", "data/simulation/sim_fits_wcov.rds"))
prepared_paths <- prepared_paths[file.exists(prepared_paths)]
if (!length(prepared_paths)) stop("Run 3c.0 or provide saved main covariate prediction rows")
fits <- as.data.table(readRDS(prepared_paths[1L]))
evaluation_ids <- unique(covariate_diagnostics$id)
fits <- fits[i %in% evaluation_ids]
stopifnot(!anyNA(fits$i), all(fits$i %in% evaluation_ids))
print(decision)
fits[i %in% 1:5, .(model, s, r, y, y0_hat, y0_post_1)]
```

ADD POISSON NOISE
```{r}
# Convert latent mean draws into predictive count draws by adding Poisson observation noise.
# This changes posterior columns in memory; it is needed for predictive coverage and scoring.
draw_cols <- grep("^y0_post_", names(fits), value = TRUE)
fits[, (draw_cols) := lapply(.SD, function(lam) rpois(.N, lam)),
     .SDcols = draw_cols]
fits[i %in% 1:5, .(model, s, r, n, y, y0_hat, y0_post_1)]
```

CUMULATE 
```{r}
# Accumulate outcomes, fitted means and posterior draws within each county/model/replication.
# Sort event times explicitly before cumulative sums.
draw_cols <- grep("^y0_post_", names(fits), value = TRUE)
# Create cumulative sums by i, ordered by event_time
# cumulative within unit
setorderv(fits, c("dgp", "nc", "model", "r", "i", "s"))
fits[, c("n", "y", "y0_hat", draw_cols) := lapply(.SD, cumsum)
     , by = .(dgp, nc, model, r, i)
     , .SDcols = c("n", "y", "y0_hat", draw_cols)]


fits[, .(dgp, r, i, start_year, model, s, n, y, y0_hat, y0_post_1)]
```

FILTER 
```{r}
# Apply the frozen numeric cutoff to each model's covariate diagnostics, not new quantiles.
# Unavailable diagnostics are excluded from the restricted sample and counted separately.
rule_flags <- fixed_rule_flags(covariate_diagnostics, decision)
lookup <- unique(fits[, .(scenario = as.character(dgp), model = as.character(model),
                         sim = r, id = i, x = start_year_sim)])
rule_flags[, present := TRUE]
matched <- merge(lookup, rule_flags, by = c("sim", "scenario", "model", "id", "x"), all.x = TRUE)
if (anyNA(matched$present)) stop("Missing county/model held-out summaries; refresh 3c.0.")
flags <- matched[, .(dgp = scenario, model, r = sim, i = id,
                    start_year_sim = x, keep, diagnostic_available)]
# Character join keys avoid ordered-factor level differences between saved branches.
fits[, `:=`(dgp = as.character(dgp), model = as.character(model))]
fits[flags, `:=`(keep = i.keep, diagnostic_available = i.diagnostic_available),
     on = .(dgp, model, r, i, start_year_sim)]
stopifnot(!anyNA(fits$keep))
fits[, dgp := ordered(dgp, levels = c("MAR", "Latent level", "Latent trend"))]
fits[, model := ordered(model, levels = c("TWFE", "ETWFE", "RW", "RW-IID", "RW-ST", "GB-Ens"))]
rule_counts <- matched[, .(counties = .N, diagnostic_unavailable = sum(!diagnostic_available),
  retained = sum(keep), retained_share = mean(keep)), by = .(scenario, model, sim)]
fwrite(rule_counts, file.path(covariate_output_dir, "fixed_rule_counts.csv"))
yaml::write_yaml(c(decision, list(evaluation_half = evaluation_half)),
                 file.path(covariate_output_dir, "applied_decision.yml"))
rule_counts[, .(mean_retained_share = mean(retained_share),
               mean_diagnostic_unavailable = mean(diagnostic_unavailable)), by = .(scenario, model)]

```


AVG (restricted by fixed no-covariate rule)
```{r}
# Average cumulative outcomes and draws across retained counties within each replication, then score and export.
# The correct RMSE is se_diff; formatting to three decimals happens after summ_score().
fits_avg <- copy(fits)
fits_avg <- fits_avg[keep == TRUE]

fits_avg <- fits_avg[, c(
  lapply(.SD, mean),
  list(
    pcor = cor(y, y0_hat, use = "complete.obs")
    , scor = cor(y, y0_hat, use = "complete.obs", method = "spearman")
  )
), by = .(nc, dgp, model, s, r), .SDcols = c("y", "y0_hat", draw_cols)]

fits_avg[, .(dgp, model, r, s, pcor, scor)]
#------------------------------------------
#score
#------------------------------------------
fits_avg |> score_avg()
setkey(fits_avg, nc, dgp, s, model)

fits_avg[, summ_score(.SD, sd = TRUE), by = .(nc, dgp, model, s)] |>
  gt() |>
  fmt_number(columns = where(is.numeric), decimals = 3) |>
  gtsave("results/tables/performance_table_avg_wcov.html")
```

AVG (full evaluation-half sample)
```{r}
# Repeat county aggregation and scoring for the full sample, without the reliability restriction.
# Export the full-sample performance table; se_diff is already the correctly computed RMSE.
fits_avg_full <- copy(fits)

#------------------------------------------

    , scor = cor(y, y0_hat, use = "complete.obs", method = "spearman")
  )
), by = .(nc, dgp, model, s, r), .SDcols = c("y", "y0_hat", draw_cols)]

#------------------------------------------
#score
#------------------------------------------
fits_avg_full |> score_avg()
setkey(fits_avg_full, nc, dgp, s, model)
fits_avg_full[, .(nc, dgp, model, s, r, sq_diff)]
fits_avg_full[dgp == "MAR" & nc == "NonCore" & s == 0 & r == 2
              , .(dgp, model, s, r, sq_diff, abs_diff)]
#there is just one dicrepancy per replication

fits_avg_full[, summ_score(.SD), by = .(nc, dgp, model, s)] |>
  gt() |>
  fmt_number(columns = where(is.numeric), decimals = 3) |>
  gtsave("results/tables/performance_table_avg_full_wcov.html")
```


```{r}
# Define the covariate-analysis colors, score reshaping and performance boxplot helper.
# Use these helpers to compare cumulative prediction errors across sample variants.
model_colors <- c(
  "TWFE"    = "#1b9e77",
  "ETWFE"   = "#66c2a5",
  "RW"      = "#a6cee3",
  "RW-IID"  = "#1f78b4",
  "RW-ST"   = "#08306b",
  "GB-Ens"  = "#e69f00"
)

dt_for_plot <- \(dt) {
  psdt <- copy(dt)
  psdt <- dt[
    , .(dgp, model, nc, s, r, abs_diff, cvg, crps, intv)
  ] |>
    melt(
      # ID variables to keep as is
      id.vars = c("dgp", "r", "model", "nc", "s")
      # Measure variables to convert to long format
      , measure.vars = c("abs_diff", "cvg", "crps", "intv")
      # Name of the new column identifying the measure
      , variable.name = "measure"
      # Name of the new column containing values
      , value.name = "value"
    )

  psdt[, measure := factor(
    measure
    , levels = c("abs_diff", "cvg", "crps", "intv")
    , labels = c("Absolute Error", "95% CI Coverage", "CRPS", "Interval Score")
  )]

  psdt[, s := ordered(
    s
    , levels = 0:4
    , labels = paste0("Year ", 0:4)
  )]
  psdt
}

plot_performance <- \(dt
  , grp = "NonCore", measure_name =  "Absolute Error", year = c("Year 0", "Year 4")
) {
  psdt <- dt_for_plot(dt)
  plot_dt <- psdt[nc == grp & measure == measure_name & s %in% year]

  #lower <- 0
  #upper <- quantile(plot_dt$value, 0.5, na.rm = TRUE)
  
  # TWFE median per facet (s, dgp)
  ref_dt <- plot_dt[model == "TWFE",
    .(twfe_median = median(value, na.rm = TRUE)), by = .(s, dgp)
  ]

  pp <- plot_dt |>
    ggplot(aes(y = value, x = model, fill = model)) +
    geom_hline(
      data = ref_dt,
      aes(yintercept = twfe_median),
      linetype = "dashed",
      color = "grey55",
      linewidth = 0.5
    ) +
    # Boxplots
    geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA, outliers = FALSE, alpha = 0.7) +
    # Faceting by dgp
    facet_grid(s ~ dgp, scales = "free_y") +
    # Formatting
    xlab("model") +
    ylab(measure_name) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = model_colors) +
    theme_classic(base_size = 12) +
    theme(
      strip.background = element_blank(),
      strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"),
      axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 30, hjust = 1),
      panel.spacing = unit(1, "lines"),
      legend.position = "none"
    )
  pp
}
```

```{r}
# Define coverage summaries and plots using the binomial Monte Carlo SE sqrt(p*(1-p)/R).
# Display nominal 95% coverage and clipped normal-approximation Monte Carlo uncertainty bands.
dt_for_cvg <- \(dt) {
  cov_sum <- copy(dt)
  # pp should contain one row per replication with columns:
  # model, world, s (Year 0/Year 4), cvg (0/1)
  cov_sum <- cov_sum[, .(
    n = .N,
    p = mean(cvg)     # estimated coverage
  ), by = .(model, dgp, nc, s)]

  # Normal approx SE (fine at n=200); or use p*(1-p)/n
  cov_sum[, se := sqrt(p * (1 - p) / n)]
  cov_sum[, `:=`(lo = p - 1.96 * se, hi = p + 1.96 * se)]
  cov_sum[, `:=`(lo = pmax(0, lo), hi = pmin(1, hi))]
  cov_sum[, s := ordered(
    s
    , levels = 0:4
    , labels = paste0("Year ", 0:4)
  )]
  cov_sum
}


plot_cvg <- \(dt, grp) {
  cov_sum <- dt_for_cvg(dt)
  cp <- cov_sum[s %in% c("Year 0", "Year 4") & nc == grp] |>
    ggplot(aes(x = model, y = p, col = model)) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0.95, linetype = 2) +
    geom_point(size = 2) +
    geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = lo, ymax = hi), width = 0.15) +
    facet_grid(s ~ dgp) +
    scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 1)) +
    labs(y = "Coverage (95% interval)", x = NULL) +
    scale_color_manual(values = model_colors) +
    theme_classic(base_size = 12) +
    theme(
      strip.background = element_blank(),
      strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"),
      axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 30, hjust = 1),
      panel.spacing = unit(1, "lines"),
      legend.position = "none"
    )
  png(paste0("results/figures/performance_plot_", grp, "_cvg_wcov.png")
    , width = 480 * 5, height = 480 * 3, res = 300
  )
  cp
  dev.off()
  cp
}
```
